1081: God, the Doer, makes the body a worthy vessel
for one touched by the company of the saints.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ਬਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ; ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
Through the Lord's bani his renown becomes pure; his mind is dyed in the Name's fast madder colour. ॥15॥
He has blossomed perfect, with all sixteen phases,
when the Lord of infinite power has risen (in his heart).
ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ ॥੧੬॥੨॥੯॥
Bliss, joy and peace come through the Lord's Name, Nanak; he savours the Lord's nectar essence. ॥16॥2॥9॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
You are the Master; I am the servant You made;
soul and body are all Your gift.
ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ; ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ. ਅਸਾੜਾ ॥੧॥
You alone, You alone are the Doer and Cause of all; nothing is ours. ॥1॥
ਤੁਮਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ; ਤਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
When You sent us, we came into the world;
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
whatever pleases You, those deeds we do.
ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਹੋਆ; ਤਾ ਭੀ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾੜਾ ॥੨॥
Nothing happens outside of You; yet You have no anxiety. ॥2॥
here Your praises, O Lord, are uttered.
ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ; ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ, ਝਾੜਾ ॥੩॥
You Yourself write the accounts and You Yourself are beyond account; no one can quarrel with You. ॥3॥
You are the Father; all are Your children;
as You make them play, so they play.
ਉਝੜ ਮਾਰਗੁ, ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ; ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ, ਕੋ ਵੇਪਾੜਾ ॥੪॥
The wilderness and the path — You made them all; no one can take the wrong way (on their own). ॥4॥
Some You keep seated at home;
some You send abroad to foreign lands.
ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਘਾਸੁ. ਇਕ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਰਾਜਾ; ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕੂੜਾ ॥੫॥
Some are grass-cutters, some are kings — which of these can be called false? ॥5॥
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੀ; ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਨਰਕਾ ॥
Who is liberated, who is in hell?
Who is worldly, who is a devotee?
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਦਾਨਾ. ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਹੋਛਾ; ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਸੁਰਤਾ. ਕਵਨੁ ਜੜਾ ॥੬॥
Who is wise, who is shallow? Who is aware, who is dull? ॥6॥
By His command one is liberated, by His command one is in hell;
by His command one is worldly, by His command a devotee;
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੋਛਾ. ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਾਨਾ; ਦੂਜਾ. ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਧੜਾ ॥੭॥
by His command one is shallow, by His command wise; there is no other side. ॥7॥
You made the ocean (of the world) utterly vast;
ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਕਰਿ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥
some foolish self-willed You have sunk in the nether world;
ਇਕਨਾ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਹਿ ਆਪੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੇੜਾ ॥੮॥
some You Yourself carry across, whose true boat is the True Guru. ॥8॥
By His command He sent death, this play;
creating beings and creatures, He takes them back.
ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ; ਰਚਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਆਖਾੜਾ ॥੯॥
He beholds, rejoices and enjoys all delights; He has made the creation an arena. ॥9॥
Great is the Master, great His glory;
great the Giver, great His place.
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਤੋਲਾ; ਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਹਾੜਾ ॥੧੦॥
Inaccessible, imperceptible, infinite, unweighable — there is no measure for Him. ॥10॥
the Immaculate One is Himself His own worship.
ਆਪਿ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ. ਆਪਿ ਧਿਆਨੀ; ਆਪਿ ਸਤਵੰਤਾ ਅਤਿ ਗਾੜਾ ॥੧੧॥
He Himself is the wise one, Himself the meditator; He Himself is of utterly solid virtue. ॥11॥
For so many ages He was said to be hidden;
for so many ages He was absorbed in the void;
ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਾ; ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਰਗਟੜਾ ॥੧੨॥
for so many ages there was pitch darkness; then the Creator Himself became manifest. ॥12॥
He Himself is called the mighty Power (Maya);
1082: He Himself is the hero who makes His command prevail;
ਆਪੇ ਸਿਵ ਵਰਤਾਈਅਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਆਪੇ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਠਾਰੁ ਗੜਾ ॥੧੩॥
He Himself spreads peace within (all); He Himself is cool as hail. ॥13॥
One whom He blesses, He fashions anew through the Guru;
the Name dwells in him, and the unstruck music plays.
ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਠਕੁਰਾਈ; ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੪॥
His is peace, his is lordship; Death does not come near him. ॥14॥
His worth cannot be told on paper;
says Nanak, the Lord of the world is infinite.
ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਅੰਤਿ, ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ; ਹਾਥਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਨੇਬੇੜਾ ॥੧੫॥
In the beginning, middle and end, He is God; the judgement is in His hands. ॥15॥
No one is His equal, O brother;
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਬੁਤੈ; ਜਬਾਬੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
no one can say no to any of His doings.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚੋਜ ਖੜਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੧੦॥
Nanak's God is Himself all; creating and creating, He stands and watches His wonders. ॥16॥1॥10॥
O Imperishable, Transcendent Lord, Supreme God, Inner-knower,
Slayer of the demon Madhu, Damodar, Master,
ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸ ਗੋਵਰਧਨ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੁਰਲੀ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
Rikhikes (Lord of the senses), Lifter of mount Govardhan, enchanting Flute-player, Lord of many plays. ॥1॥
dear Lord of the world, Destroyer of demons,
ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਘਟ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
Life of the world, imperishable Lord, You dwell in every heart and are with all. ॥2॥
Support of the earth, Lord, Narsingh, Narayan,
who held the earth on the tip of His tusks,
ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਤੇ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
You, O Creator, took the form of the dwarf; You are with all, yet sublime above all. ॥3॥
ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ; ਜਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ॥
You are Sri Ramchand, who has no form or feature;
the Garlanded One, Wielder of the discus, of incomparable form;
ਸਹਸ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ. ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ; ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ. ਸਭ ਹੈ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੪॥
You have thousands of eyes and thousands of forms; You alone are the Giver, all are beggars. ॥4॥
Lover of devotion, Master of the masterless,
Lord of the milkmaids, You are with all;
ਬਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦਾਤੇ; ਬਰਨਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ, ਗੁਣ ਅੰਗਾ ॥੫॥
O Vasudev, Immaculate Giver, I cannot describe Your virtues. ॥5॥
Mukand (Liberator), Enticer, Narayan, Lord of Lakshmi,
ਕਮਲਾਕੰਤ. ਕਰਹਿ ਕੰਤੂਹਲ; ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦੀ ਨਿਹਸੰਗਾ ॥੬॥
Lord of Kamla (Lakshmi), You stage wondrous plays; You enjoy all delights, yet are unattached. ॥6॥
Your vision is fruitful; You are unborn, self-existent;
ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨਾਹੀ ਖਉ ॥
ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਅਗੋਚਰ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਲਗਾ ॥੭॥
Imperishable, Unmanifest, Imperceptible — everything depends on You. ॥7॥
O Lord of Lakshmi, Dweller in heaven,
the fish and the tortoise incarnations came by Your command;
ਕੇਸਵ ਚਲਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ; ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਗਾ ॥੮॥
O Keshav (of beautiful hair), You perform wondrous plays; whatever You wish, that shall be. ॥8॥
You need no food, You are without enmity, all-pervading;
staging the play, You are called the four-armed (Brahma);
ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰੂਪ ਬਣਾਵਹਿ; ਬੇਣੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੈਗਾ ॥੯॥
You make beautiful dark forms; hearing Your flute, all are enchanted. ॥9॥
Adorned with garlands of the forest, lotus-eyed,
with beautiful earrings, crown and flute,
ਸੰਖ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਧਾਰੀ; ਮਹਾ ਸਾਰਥੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੦॥
Bearer of conch, discus and mace — You are the great Charioteer of the holy congregation. ॥10॥
O Lord in yellow robes, Master of the three worlds,
Lord of the world, Sustainer — I utter Your Names with my mouth.
ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ; ਮੈ ਗਣਤ. ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਸਰਬੰਗਾ ॥੧੧॥
O Bowman, Lord God, Beethal (beyond Maya), I cannot count all Your attributes. ॥11॥
He is said to be without enemy, utterly detached;
Dhananjai (Conqueror), He is in water, land and earth;
1083: ਮਿਰਤ ਲੋਕ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਮੀਪਤ; ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਭਗਾ ॥੧੨॥
near in the mortal world and the nether regions; His place is permanent and unbreakable. ॥12॥
Purifier of sinners, Destroyer of pain and fear,
Remover of ego, Eradicator of the cycle of birth;
ਭਗਤੀ ਤੋਖਿਤ. ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਗੁਣੇ; ਨ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਭਿਗਾ ॥੧੩॥
merciful to the meek, He is pleased with devotion, and won by no other virtue. ॥13॥
The Formless One is undeceivable, unshakeable;
He is Light embodied; the whole world blossoms (in Him).
ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਆਪਹੁ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੪॥
He alone meets Him whom He Himself unites; no one finds Him by his own effort. ॥14॥
He Himself is the milkmaid, He Himself Krishna;
He Himself grazes the cows in the forest.
ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ; ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ. ਨਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ, ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧੫॥
You Yourself create and Yourself destroy; not a particle of colour sticks to You. ॥15॥
Which of Your virtues can my one tongue describe?
ਸਹਸ ਫਨੀ ਸੇਖ; ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Even the thousand-headed serpent Shesh does not know Your limit;
ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਮ, ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਇਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ, ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੬॥
he chants new Names night and day, yet cannot tell even one of God's virtues. ॥16॥
I have grasped Your support and come to Your refuge, O Father of the world;
ਭੈ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਦੁਤਰ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
the messengers of Death are terrifying; Maya is hard to cross.
ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਇਛਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
Be merciful and by Your will keep me in the company of the holy saints. ॥17॥
All that is seen is false;
ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ; ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
I beg one gift, O Lord of the universe: the dust of the saints.
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਉ; ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੮॥
Applying it to my forehead, may I attain the supreme state; he alone obtains it who is destined to. ॥18॥
Those on whom the Giver of peace shows mercy
ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਲੈ; ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥
take the feet of the holy and weave them into their hearts.
ਸਗਲ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧੯॥
They obtain the treasure of the Name, above all; the unstruck Word resounds in their minds. ॥19॥
The tongue chants Your Names, made (from Your deeds);
"Sat Naam" is Your primal, most ancient Name.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ॥੨੦॥
Says Nanak, the devotees have entered Your refuge; grant them Your vision, and love wells up in the mind. ॥20॥
Your state and extent You alone know;
ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਥਹਿ; ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
You Yourself speak of it and Yourself describe it.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਾਸਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
Make Nanak the slave of Your slaves; as it pleases You, O Lord, keep him with Your slaves. ॥21॥2॥11॥
O servant of Allah, the Inaccessible, of God,
abandon the thoughts and entanglements of the world.
ਹੋਇ ਪੈ ਖਾਕ. ਫਕੀਰ ਮੁਸਾਫਰੁ; ਇਹੁ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ, ਕਬੂਲੁ ਦਰਾ ॥੧॥
Become the dust of the feet of the fakirs and a traveller; such a dervish is accepted at His door. ॥1॥
Make Truth your prayer, and faith your prayer-mat;
ਦੇਹ ਮਸੀਤਿ. ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਣਾ; ਕਲਮ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ਖਰਾ ॥੨॥
Let the body be the mosque and the mind the mullah; let pure, true living be your divine creed. ॥2॥
Let practising (the Name) be your shariat (law);
let renunciation and searching (for God within) be your tariqat (path);
ਮਾਰਫਤਿ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਹੁ ਅਬਦਾਲਾ; ਮਿਲਹੁ ਹਕੀਕਤਿ, ਜਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ. ਨ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
let subduing the mind be your marfat (knowledge), O holy man, and meeting God your haqiqat (truth), by which one does not die again. ॥3॥
Practise the Koran and the scriptures within your heart;
restrain the ten senses from straying onto evil paths;
ਪੰਚ ਮਰਦ. ਸਿਦਕਿ ਲੇ ਬਾਧਹੁ; ਖੈਰਿ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਕਬੂਲ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥
bind the five demons with faith; through the alms of contentment you will be accepted. ॥4॥
Let compassion be your Mecca, and the dust of the feet (of all) your fast;
let practising the Guru's Word fully be your paradise;
ਹੂਰ ਨੂਰ, ਮੁਸਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ; ਬੰਦਗੀ ਅਲਹ ਆਲਾ ਹੁਜਰਾ ॥੫॥
God's Light is the houris, (His worship) the musk; worship of Allah is the sublime chamber. ॥5॥
1084: He alone is a qazi who practises Truth;
he alone is a haji who purifies his heart;
ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾ ਮਲਊਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ; ਸੋ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ. ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਧਰਾ ॥੬॥
he alone is a mullah who banishes evil; he alone is a dervish whose support is His praise. ॥6॥
At all times, at every moment,
remember the Creator, the Lord, within your heart.
ਤਸਬੀ ਯਾਦਿ ਕਰਹੁ, ਦਸ ਮਰਦਨੁ; ਸੁੰਨਤਿ ਸੀਲੁ, ਬੰਧਾਨਿ ਬਰਾ ॥੭॥
Let remembrance be your rosary, subduing the ten senses; let good conduct and great self-restraint be your circumcision. ॥7॥
Know in your heart that all is transient;
family and brothers are all entanglements;
ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਉਮਰੇ ਫਾਨਾਇਆ; ਏਕ ਮੁਕਾਮ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਦਰਾ ॥੮॥
kings, rulers and nobles are perishable; only God's door is the permanent place. ॥8॥
third, humility; fourth, goodwill to all;
ਪੰਜਵੈ. ਪੰਜੇ ਇਕਤੁ ਮੁਕਾਮੈ; ਏਹਿ ਪੰਜਿ ਵਖਤ ਤੇਰੇ, ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥੯॥
fifth, (holding) the five (passions) in one place — these are your five times of prayer, most sublime. ॥9॥
Let knowing (God in) all be your daily recitation;
ਬਦ ਅਮਲ ਛੋਡਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਕੂਜਾ ॥
let abandoning evil deeds be the water-pot in your hand;
ਖੁਦਾਇ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਿ, ਦੇਵਹੁ ਬਾਂਗਾਂ; ਬੁਰਗੂ. ਬਰਖੁਰਦਾਰ ਖਰਾ ॥੧੦॥
let understanding the One God be your call to prayer; be a good child of God — let this be your trumpet. ॥10॥
Let honest earnings be the lawful food you eat;
wash away filth in the river of your heart.
ਪੀਰੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ. ਭਿਸਤੀ ਸੋਈ; ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ. ਨ ਦੋਜ ਠਰਾ ॥੧੧॥
One who recognises the Pir (Guru) goes to heaven; Azrael does not cast him into hell. ॥11॥
Make the body, the doer of deeds, your faithful wife;
enjoy the delights and plays of God's love.
ਨਾਪਾਕ. ਪਾਕੁ ਕਰਿ, ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹਦੀਸਾ; ਸਾਬਤ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਦਸਤਾਰ ਸਿਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
Purify the impure — let this be your Hadith of His presence; keep your form intact, with a turban on the head. ॥12॥
To be a Muslim is to be soft-hearted like wax,
ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ. ਦਿਲ ਤੇ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
and to wash away the filth within from the heart.
ਦੁਨੀਆ ਰੰਗ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ; ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਪਾਟੁ, ਘਿਉ ਪਾਕੁ ਹਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
He does not come near the pleasures of the world — pure like flowers, silk, ghee and the deerskin. ॥13॥
One on whom the Merciful One bestows mercy and grace
is the manliest of men, a true hero;
ਸੋਈ ਸੇਖੁ ਮਸਾਇਕੁ ਹਾਜੀ; ਸੋ ਬੰਦਾ. ਜਿਸੁ ਨਜਰਿ ਨਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
he alone is a sheikh, a preacher, a haji, he alone a slave of God, on whom is God's glance. ॥14॥
The Creator's creation, of the Generous Creator;
the praise and love of the unfathomable Merciful One;
ਹਕੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਸਚੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ਬੁਝਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬੰਦਿ ਖਲਾਸ ਤਰਾ ॥੧੫॥੩॥੧੨॥
understanding the true command of the True God, Nanak, one is released from bondage and carried across. ॥15॥3॥12॥
The Transcendent Lord is seated highest of all;
He Himself establishes, disestablishes and creates.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹਤ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਿਛੁ ਭਉ. ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ, ਬਾਲ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
Grasping God's refuge, peace is found; the fear of Maya does not touch one at all. ॥1॥
He who saved you in the fire of the womb,
who did not destroy you among the worms in the blood,
ਅਪਨਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਆ; ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਲਕਾ ॥੨॥
who cherished you by granting His remembrance — He is the Master of all hearts. ॥2॥
One who has come to the sanctuary of His lotus feet,
and sung the Lord's praises in the company of the holy —
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਭਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਲ ਕਾ ॥੩॥
He has removed all his pains of birth and death; chanting "Har, Har," he has no fear of death. ॥3॥
The all-powerful, indescribable, imperceptible, divine Lord —
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
all beings and creatures serve Him;
ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ; ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਪਾਲਕਾ ॥੪॥
the egg-born, womb-born, sweat-born and earth-born — He cherishes them in many ways. ॥4॥
who savours the essence of the Lord's Name within;
ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ; ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਸਾਲਕਾ ॥੫॥
taking them by the hand, He has pulled them from the blind well; rare are such seekers. ॥5॥
1085: In the beginning, end and middle is that God;
whatever the Creator Himself does comes to pass.
ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ. ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਤੇ; ਦਾਲਿਦ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ਘਾਲਕਾ ॥੬॥
Doubt and fear are erased through the company of the holy; no affliction can destroy them. ॥6॥
Sing the sublime bani of the Lord of the world;
beg for the dust of the company of the holy.
ਬਾਸਨ ਮੇਟਿ. ਨਿਬਾਸਨ ਹੋਈਐ; ਕਲਮਲ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਾਲਕਾ ॥੭॥
Erasing desires, one becomes desireless; all sins are burnt away. ॥7॥
This is the unique way of the saints:
they see the Transcendent Lord with them.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਕਿਉ. ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਲਕਾ ॥੮॥
With every breath they worship the Lord, "Har, Har"; how can one be lazy in remembering Him? ॥8॥
Wherever I look, there is the Inner-knower;
ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
do not forget me even for an instant, O God, my Master.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ; ਬਨਿ ਜਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਥਾਲਕਾ ॥੯॥
Your slaves live by remembering, remembering You; You pervade forests, water and land. ॥9॥
ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ. ਨ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Not even a hot wind touches him
who remains awake night and day, remembering the Name.
ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਤਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੦॥
He enjoys bliss and delight in the Lord's remembrance; he has no attachment to Maya. ॥10॥
Disease, sorrow and pain do not touch those
who sing the Lord's kirtan in the company of the holy.
ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਖਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੧॥
Grant me Your Name, O Beloved God; hear my prayer, O Creator. ॥11॥
Your Name is a jewel, O Beloved;
Your slaves are imbued with Your love, O Infinite One.
ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹੇ; ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕੇਈ ਭਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੨॥
Those imbued with Your love become like You; rare are those who are found. ॥12॥
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ, ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
My mind begs for the dust of those
who never forget You at any time.
ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈ; ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੩॥
In their company I may attain the supreme state, with the Lord ever my companion. ॥13॥
He alone is my beloved friend and companion
who implants the One and removes evil-mindedness,
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਾਏ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੪॥
who makes me give up lust, anger and ego; that person's teaching is purifying. ॥14॥
Without You, no one is mine;
the Guru has made me grasp God's feet.
ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਖੰਡਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਅਨਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੫॥
I am a sacrifice to the Perfect True Guru, who has destroyed my doubt and the storm (of vice). ॥15॥
With every breath, may I never forget God;
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
twenty-four hours a day may I meditate on the Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਵਡਾਲਕਾ ॥੧੬॥੪॥੧੩॥
Nanak, the saints are imbued with Your love; You are all-powerful and great. ॥16॥4॥13॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
May I ever enshrine His lotus feet in my heart,
and bow to the Perfect Guru every moment;
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ; ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥੧॥
offering body and mind, I place all before Him; in the world the Name is beautiful. ॥1॥
Why forget that Lord from your mind,
who gave you soul and body, fashioned and adorned you?
ਸਾਸਿ ਗਰਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਕਰਤਾ; ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੨॥
With every breath and morsel cherish the Creator; one receives the fruit of one's own deeds. ॥2॥
From whom no one goes away empty-handed —
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
keep that Lord in your mind twenty-four hours a day.
1086: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੁ ਅਚੁਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੩॥
In the company of the holy, meditate on the Imperishable Master; you will obtain glory in His court. ॥3॥
The four great blessings, the eighteen spiritual powers,
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
the nine treasures — the treasure of the Name is the peace of poise.
ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਜੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਵਣਾ ॥੪॥
If you desire all well-being in your mind, meet the holy and enjoy the Master. ॥4॥
The Shastras, Simritis and Vedas proclaim:
win the treasure of human birth, O mortal.
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰਹਰੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥੫॥
Renounce lust, anger and slander; sing of the Lord with your tongue, Nanak. ॥5॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ; ਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
He who has no form, feature, lineage or caste,
the Perfect One, pervades day and night;
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੬॥
whoever meditates on Him is very fortunate and is not cast into births again. ॥6॥
One who forgets the Primal Being, the Architect of destiny,
ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣੈ ਕਉ ਰਖੈ. ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਣਾ ॥੭॥
No one can save the ungrateful wretch; he is cast into the most terrible hell. ॥7॥
ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
He who fashioned your soul, breath, body and wealth,
who protected and blessed you in the mother's womb —
ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਛਾਡਿ. ਅਨ ਰਾਤਾ; ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਰੈ. ਨ ਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੮॥
forsaking love for Him, one is imbued with others and reaches no fulfilment. ॥8॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਹਿ; ਸਭਨ ਕੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥
You dwell in every heart, near to all.
ਹਾਥਿ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਕਛੂਐ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਜਣਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਜਣਾਵਣਾ ॥੯॥
Nothing is in our hands; he alone knows whom You cause to know. ॥9॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One on whose forehead such destiny was written from the start —
ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਪੁਰਖ. ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
that person alone is not afflicted by Maya.
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਦੂਸਰ ਲਵੈ. ਨ ਲਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੦॥
Nanak, His slaves remain ever in His refuge; they hold none other His equal. ॥10॥
By His command all pains and pleasures were made;
rare is the one who recognises the nectar Name.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੧॥
His worth cannot be told; He alone pervades everywhere. ॥11॥
He is the devotee, He is the great Giver;
He is the Perfect Primal Being, the Architect of destiny.
ਬਾਲ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ; ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੨॥
He alone is Your childhood friend who is pleasing to Your mind. ॥12॥
Death, pain and pleasure are written (in destiny);
ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਧਹਿ; ਘਟਹਿ ਨ. ਘਟਾਏ ॥
they do not increase by a particle, nor decrease when one tries to decrease them.
ਸੋਈ ਹੋਇ ਜਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ; ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਵਞਾਵਣਾ ॥੧੩॥
That alone happens which pleases the Creator; by speaking (of one's own power) one ruins oneself. ॥13॥
He pulls them out of the blind well,
and unites those separated for countless births;
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
showering mercy, He keeps them as His own; meeting the holy, they meditate on the Lord of the universe. ॥14॥
wondrous is Your form, great Your glory.
Your servant begs for the gift of devotion; Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ॥15॥1॥14॥22॥24॥2॥14॥62॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਵਿਣੁ ਗਾਹਕ. ਗੁਣੁ ਵੇਚੀਐ; ਤਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਸਹਘੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
When virtue is sold without a buyer, it goes cheap;
ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਲਾਖ ਵਿਕਾਇ ॥
if a buyer of virtue is found, it sells for hundreds of thousands.
1087: ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
Through virtue, joining the virtuous, (the Lord) is found, if one merges in the True Guru.
ਮੋੁਲਿ ਅਮੋੁਲੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਵਣਜਿ. ਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਹਾਟਿ ॥
The priceless (Name) is not obtained for a price, nor bought in a shop;
ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਹੈ; ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak, its weight is full and never falls short. ॥1॥
ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ. ਭਰਮਸਹਿ; ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Those without the Name wander, coming and going constantly;
ਇਕਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ. ਇਕਿ ਢੀਲਿਆ; ਇਕਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
some are bound, some loosened, some at peace in the Lord's love.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ; ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
Nanak, accept the True One; Truth is their deed, Truth their way of life. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅਤਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
From the Guru I obtained wisdom, a very sharp sword;
ਦੂਜਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗੜੁ ਕਟਿਆ; ਮੋਹੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
it has cut down the fortress of duality, doubt, attachment, greed and ego.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
The Lord's Name dwells in the mind, reflecting on the Guru's Word;
ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮਾ; ਹਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
through the self-discipline of Truth the intellect is sublime; the Lord has become dear.
ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
The Truest of the true pervades all; true is the Creator. ॥1॥
ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਰਾਗਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਸਬਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Among the ragas, Kedara is to be known as good, O brother, if through it one comes to love the Word,
ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਦੋ ਰਹੈ; ਸਚੇ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
keeps meeting the true congregation, and enshrines love for the True One;
ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਲੁ ਕਟੇ ਆਪਣੀ; ਕੁਲਾ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
if one cuts away his own filth from within and saves his generations;
ਗੁਣਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ; ਅਵਗਣ ਕਢੈ ਵਿਡਾਰਿ ॥
if one gathers the capital of virtues and drives out and destroys faults.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਗੁਰੂ. ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਆਪਣਾ, ਦੂਜੈ. ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
Nanak, he is known to be united who does not forsake his Guru nor love duality. ॥1॥
ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਉ. ਡਰਿ ਮਰਉ; ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Seeing the ocean, I die of fright; but in Your fear there is no fear;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
through the Guru's Word I am content; Nanak, I blossom in the Name. ॥2॥
ਚੜਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਚਾਲਸਉ; ਸਾਗਰੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
Boarding the ship, I shall set out, though the ocean surges with waves;
ਠਾਕ ਨ. ਸਚੈ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ; ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੀਰਕ ਦੇਇ ॥
the true ship meets no obstacle if the Guru gives courage.
ਤਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਉਤਾਰੀਆ; ਗੁਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨੁ ॥
He will land me at that door; the Guru appears watchful.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Nanak, by His grace it is obtained, and one is honoured in His court. ॥3॥
ਨਿਹਕੰਟਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
Enjoy the kingdom free of thorns, practising Truth through the Guru;
ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਕਰਿ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
seated on His true throne, He dispenses justice and unites one with the true congregation.
ਸਚਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
The true teaching is to meditate on the Lord; one's love for the Lord is formed.
ਐਥੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
Here, the Giver of peace dwells in the mind; in the end He becomes one's companion.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਊਪਜੀ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Love for the Lord wells up when the Guru has given understanding. ॥2॥
ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰੀ; ਪਾਧਰੁ ਕਹੈ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Straying, straying, I wander; no one tells me the level path;
ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਆਣਿਆ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
go and ask the wise — may someone remove my pain.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਾਜਨੁ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਠਾਇ ॥
If the True Guru dwells in the mind, the Friend is found right there;
ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀਐ; ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, the mind is satisfied through praise of the True Name. ॥1॥
ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ; ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
He Himself is the Doer of deeds; He Himself acts by His will;
ਆਪੇ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ; ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
He Himself forgives some; He Himself does the work.
ਨਾਨਕ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ; ਦੁਖ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਲੀ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, meeting the Guru there is light; pain and poison are burnt away by the Name. ॥2॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਵੇਖਿ. ਨ ਭੁਲੁ ਤੂ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਰਖਾ ॥
Do not be fooled by seeing Maya, O foolish self-willed one;
ਚਲਦਿਆ. ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ; ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਲਖਾ ॥
it does not go with you when you depart; know all wealth to be false.
ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝਈ; ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ. ਜਮ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਲਖਾ ॥
The blind ignorant one does not understand that the sword of Death hangs over his head.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ; ਜਿਨ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਖਾ ॥
By the Guru's grace those are saved who have tasted the Lord's essence;
1088: ਆਪਿ; ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ; ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਾ ॥੩॥
the Lord Himself makes them act, Himself acts, and Himself protects. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨਾ. ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਭੈ ਕੀ. ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
Those who have not met the Guru have not a particle of His fear;
ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ; ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਚਿੰਦ ॥
coming and going they suffer great pain; their anxiety never ends.
ਕਾਪੜ ਜਿਵੈ ਪਛੋੜੀਐ; ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤ ਘੜੀਆਲੁ ॥
As clothes are beaten on the washing stone, as the gong is struck hour after hour,
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸਿਰਹੁ. ਨ ਚੁਕੈ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
so, Nanak, without the True Name the entanglement does not leave one's head. ॥1॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਢੂਢੀ ਸਜਣਾ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬੁਰੀ ਜਗਤਿ ॥
I have searched the three worlds, O Friend: ego is evil in the world;
ਨਾ ਝੁਰੁ ਹੀਅੜੇ. ਸਚੁ ਚਉ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ॥੨॥
do not grieve, O heart; speak the Truth, Nanak — the Truest of the true. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
He Himself has forgiven the Guru-facing; they merge in the Lord's Name;
ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੇ ॥
He Himself has attached them to devotion, marked with the insignia of the Guru's Word.
ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
Facing Him, they are ever beautiful, known at the true door.
ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥
Here and hereafter they are liberated who have recognised the Lord.
ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ. ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥
Blessed, blessed are those who have served the Lord; I am a sacrifice to them. ॥4॥
ਮਹਲ ਕੁਚਜੀ, ਮੜਵੜੀ; ਕਾਲੀ ਮਨਹੁ ਕਸੁਧ ॥
The bride is ill-mannered, ugly and wretched, black and impure in mind;
ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਨਿ. ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੁੰਧ ॥੧॥
if she had virtues, her Husband would enjoy her; Nanak, the bride is full of faults. ॥1॥
ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਲ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੀ; ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ॥
She who has truthful conduct and true self-discipline is accepted in her family;
ਨਾਨਕ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਭਲੀ; ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
Nanak, day and night she is ever good, in love and affection for her Husband. ॥2॥
ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One who has recognised his own self has found the treasure of the Name;
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
in His mercy, He has united him through the Guru's Word.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
The Guru's bani is pure; through it He gives the Lord's essence to drink.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਅਨ ਰਸ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
Those who have tasted the Lord's essence have held back other tastes;
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ. ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭਏ; ਫਿਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
drinking the Lord's essence, they are ever satisfied, and have lost craving and hunger. ॥5॥
ਪਿਰ ਖੁਸੀਏ. ਧਨ ਰਾਵੀਏ; ਧਨ ਉਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
The Husband is pleased, and the bride enjoys Him; the bride is adorned with the Name in her heart.
ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨ ਆਗੈ ਖੜੀ; ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak, the bride who stands before Him is the glorious woman. ॥1॥
ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਕੰਤ ਕੀ; ਕੰਤੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥
In her in-laws' home and her parents' home she belongs to the Husband; the Husband is inaccessible and unfathomable.
ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੨॥
Nanak, blessed are the happy brides who are pleasing to the Carefree Lord. ॥2॥
ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੋ ਬਹੈ; ਜਿ ਤਖਤੈ ਲਾਇਕ ਹੋਈ ॥
He alone sits on the throne as king who is worthy of the throne;
ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਸਚੁ ਰਾਜੇ ਸੇਈ ॥
those who have recognised the True One are the true kings.
ਏਹਿ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ. ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
These lords of the earth are not to be called kings; in the love of duality they suffer pain.
ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਜਾਦੇ ਬਿਲਮ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Why praise what is created, which takes no time to depart?
ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ. ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
The True One alone is unmoving; one who understands through the Guru becomes unmoving too. ॥6॥
ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਖਾਲੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
The One is the Husband of all; none is without the Husband;
ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak, they are the happy brides who merge in the True Guru. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਕੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਤਰੰਗ; ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਛੁਟੀਐ ॥
The mind has many waves; how can one be released at the Master's door?
ਜੇ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ; ਗੂੜੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
If one is absorbed in the true colour, in the deep colour of the Infinite,
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੁਟੀਐ; ਜੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ॥੨॥
then, Nanak, one is released by the Guru's grace, if the mind is attached to the True One. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ; ਕਿਉ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
The Lord's Name is priceless; how can its worth be assessed?
1089: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ; ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੀਜੈ ॥
He Himself fashioned the whole universe; He Himself pervades it.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
Through the Guru, praise Him forever; Truth is the price that is paid.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿਆ; ਇਵ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
Through the Guru's Word the lotus blossoms; thus the Lord's essence is drunk.
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿਆ; ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਵੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
Coming and going are stopped, and one sleeps in peace and poise. ॥7॥
ਨਾ ਮੈਲਾ. ਨਾ ਧੁੰਧਲਾ; ਨਾ ਭਗਵਾ. ਨਾ ਕਚੁ ॥
Not filthy, not dull, not saffron (garbed), not fickle —
ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ; ਸਚੈ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
Nanak, he is deep crimson, imbued with the True One, true. ॥1॥
ਸਹਜਿ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ. ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ; ਭਵਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਖੰਡਿ ॥
In poise the bumblebee dwells amid the flowers and fruits of the vegetation, having shattered fear;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਏਕੋ ਫੁਲੁ ਭਿਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak, there is one Tree, one flower, one bumblebee. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ; ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
Those who wrestle with their minds are the foremost heroes;
ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ; ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
those who have recognised their own selves remain ever united with the Lord.
ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਹੈ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
This is the glory of the wise: they remain absorbed within their minds.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਚੁ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
They have reached the dear Lord's mansion, focusing their attention on the True One.
ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ. ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ; ਜਗੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਜਿਤਾਨਾ ॥੮॥
Those who by the Guru's grace have conquered the mind have conquered the world. ॥8॥
ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਗਿ ਭਵਾ; ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਲੇਉ ॥
If I became a yogi and wandered the world, begging from door to door,
ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਕਿਸੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
when called to account in His court, for which (deeds) could I answer?
ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ. ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮੜੀ; ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
Let the Name be the alms and contentment the hut; then the True One is ever with you.
ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ. ਨ ਲਧੀਆ; ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
Nothing is gained by religious garbs; all are bound by Death.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗਲਾ ਝੂਠੀਆ; ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak, talk is false; cherish the True Name. ॥1॥
ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Do not serve at a door where one is called to account;
ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ; ਜਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
seek out such a True Guru, than whom there is none greater.
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
In His refuge one is released, and no one calls one to account.
ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ. ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ; ਸਚਾ ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
He Himself is firm in Truth and implants Truth; He gives the true Word.
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
One with Truth in his heart — his body and mind too become true.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ; ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
Nanak, obeying the True One's command, one is given true glory;
ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਸੀ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
one on whom He casts His glance merges in the True One. ॥2॥
ਸੂਰੇ ਏਹਿ. ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ; ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
They are not called heroes who die in ego and suffer pain;
ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ. ਨ ਪਛਾਣਨੀ; ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
the blind do not recognise their own selves; they rot in duality.
ਅਤਿ ਕਰੋਧ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝਦੇ; ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
They fight with great anger and suffer here and hereafter.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ, ਨ ਭਾਵਈ; ਵੇਦ ਕੂਕਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ॥
The dear Lord is not pleased with ego; the Vedas proclaim this aloud.
ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮੁਏ, ਸੇ ਵਿਗਤੀ ਗਏ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੯॥
Those who died in ego departed unredeemed; they die and are born, coming again. ॥9॥
ਕਾਗਉ ਹੋਇ. ਨ ਊਜਲਾ; ਲੋਹੇ ਨਾਵ. ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
A crow does not become white; an iron boat does not cross over;
ਪਿਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ; ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
but one who accepts the treasure of the Beloved — blessed is the Adorner (Guru).
ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਊਜਲਾ; ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
One who recognises the command becomes bright; as iron crosses over on wood.
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਛੋਡੈ ਭੈ ਵਸੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
Renounce craving and dwell in His fear, Nanak — this is the excellent deed. ॥1॥
ਮਾਰੂ ਮਾਰਣ ਜੋ ਗਏ; ਮਾਰਿ. ਨ ਸਕਹਿ, ਗਵਾਰ ॥
Those who went to the deserts to kill (the mind) cannot kill it, the fools;
ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Nanak, this (mind) is killed only by reflecting on the Guru's Word.
ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ. ਨਾ ਮਰੈ; ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
This mind does not die by killing, though everyone may long for it;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ; ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, the mind itself kills the mind, if one meets that True Guru. ॥2॥
1090: ਦੋਵੈ ਤਰਫਾ ਉਪਾਈਓਨੁ; ਵਿਚਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
He created both sides; within them dwell Shakti (Maya) and Shiv (soul).
ਸਕਤੀ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
No one has found Him through Shakti (Maya); one is born and dies again.
ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ. ਸਾਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਪਿ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
Serving the Guru, peace is found, meditating with every breath and morsel.
ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖੁ; ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
Search the Simritis and Shastras and see: sublime are the Lord's slaves.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ, ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ; ਨਾਮੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੧੦॥
Nanak, without the Name nothing is permanent; I am a sacrifice to the Name. ॥10॥
ਹੋਵਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋਤਕੀ; ਵੇਦ ਪੜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
I might become a pandit, an astrologer, and recite the four Vedas by heart;
ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਮਧੇ ਪੂਜੀਆ; ਅਪਣੈ ਚਜਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
I might be worshipped across the nine regions for my conduct and thought;
ਮਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਭੁਲਿ ਜਾਇ; ਚਉਕੈ ਭਿਟੈ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
(but) beware lest the True Word be forgotten — (what matter that) no one defiles my kitchen square?
ਝੂਠੇ ਚਉਕੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
False are kitchen squares, Nanak; the One alone is true. ॥1॥
ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ. ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ; ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
He Himself creates, He Himself acts; He Himself casts His glance;
ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
He Himself grants glories; says Nanak, He is the True One. ॥2॥
ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਹੋਰੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ. ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
Death is the one thorn; no other thorn is perceived;
ਅਫਰਿਓ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਪਾਪੀ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
irresistible, it pervades the world and wrestles with sinners.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਦੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Through the Guru's Word one is pierced by the Lord; meditating on the Lord, one understands the Lord.
ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ; ਜੋ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝੈ ॥
One who struggles with his mind is released in the Lord's refuge.
ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੧੧॥
One who reflects in his mind and meditates on the Lord succeeds in the Lord's court. ॥11॥
ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਸਾਖਤੀ; ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
By the Commander's command comes harmony (with Him); in His court Truth is accepted.
ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ; ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ. ਨ ਭੂਲੁ ॥
The Master will call for the account; do not be misled by seeing the world.
ਦਿਲ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ; ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਦਿਲੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
One who guards his heart, whose dervishhood is keeping the heart straight —
ਇਸਕ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਲੇਖਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
Nanak, the account of his love and affection is with the Creator. ॥1॥
Detached, the bumblebee sees the Lord of the world everywhere;
ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਠਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
the diamond (soul) is pierced by the Diamond (Lord); Nanak, it clings to His neck in love. ॥2॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਆਪਦਾ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
Death afflicts the self-willed, attached to Maya;
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾੜਸੀ; ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਠਾਗੇ ॥
in an instant it strikes down those cheated by duality.
ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
When Death's club strikes, the chance does not come again.
ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ. ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
Death's club does not strike those who are awake, attuned to the Lord.
ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ. ਤੁਧੁ ਛਡਾਵਣੀ; ਸਭ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧੨॥
All is Yours, You alone release; all cling to You. ॥12॥
ਸਰਬੇ ਜੋਇ ਅਗਛਮੀ; ਦੂਖੁ ਘਨੇਰੋ ਆਥਿ ॥
One who sees everything as everlasting suffers great pain;
ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਸਿ, ਸਰੁ ਲਾਘਣਉ; ਲਾਭੁ ਨ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੧॥
he loads salt-earth and must cross the ocean; he has neither profit nor capital with him. ॥1॥
ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੂ; ਅਖੁਟਉ ਦਰਬੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
The True Name is the capital; You are the inexhaustible, infinite wealth;
ਨਾਨਕ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਉ; ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak, pure is this merchandise; blessed is the banker, blessed the trade. ॥2॥
ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਪਿਰਾਣਿ ਲੈ; ਮੋਟਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥
Recognise the primal love; enjoy the great Lord;
ਮਾਥੈ ਊਭੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਣੁ ਨਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
Death will be struck down on its face; Nanak, union comes through the Name. ॥3॥
ਆਪੇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਓਨੁ; ਵਿਚਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
He Himself adorned the body, and placed within it the nine treasures of the Name;
ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨੁ; ਤਿਨ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
some He Himself has led astray in doubt; their work is fruitless.
ਇਕਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
Some, through the Guru, have understood the Lord, the all-pervading Soul;
ਇਕਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
some have heard and believed — the Lord, the sublime deed.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ; ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧੩॥
Love for the Lord has welled up within those who sang the Lord's praises and the Name. ॥13॥
